arguments.text: 10 km, 8 legs of 1250 m out-and-back. Goal fastest finish. 1) Let the start settle; pod power should come to about CP (pod 195 W, boat 122 W) by min 3; ease if still well above CP at min 3. 2) Hold just at/under CP mid-race, watch reserve (w_bal_pod_frac) and HR trend; consider one short test piece to check CP if HR/reserve disagree. 3) Watch for incidents: speed dips at steady pod power (weed on rudder -> clear_rudder), pod vs GPS disagreement (pod drift), radio course change (set_race_distance + tell), wind shifts. 4) Spend reserve over last ~1.5-2 km; finish cue around 600-800 m to go.

arguments.source:
w = window("share", 240)
base = median(w[:-40])
share_drop = w[-1] / base - 1.0
arguments.description: share of pod power reaching the boat now vs the median of the 4 minutes before (fraction); a sudden drop = drag (weed), pod change or current change
